newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open a shade easier, small bounce seen.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open a shade easier, small bounce seen.

text.p: UK shares were a touch easier at the start, but the market is expected to regain its firmer bias on Tuesday ahead of the holiday-shortened session, dealers said. At 0835 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 index was down 0.5 point at 4,086.7.
Gilts were flat in early dealings, while the Dow, up about 20 points when London markets closed, ended with just a 4.62 point gain last night at 6,489.02.
